_comment: Single source of truth for API-key roles and the scopes they grant. Consumed by the Python API (dbcore/rbac.py enforces scopes per endpoint), the Qwik dashboard (role picker on /dashboard/settings) and the MCP server (filters which tools a key can see and call). Keep roles additive: each role is a superset of the previous one. Project public keys (retro_pub_*) are NOT API keys: they can only call the ingest endpoints and carry no role.

scopes.projects:read: List and read projects and their settings.
scopes.projects:write: Create and update projects, rotate the public key, change board settings.
scopes.feedback:read: List and read feedback items, notes and screenshots; read summaries.
scopes.feedback:write: Change status, priority, tags; add notes; promote to the roadmap.
scopes.board:read: Read roadmap items and changelog entries (including drafts).
scopes.board:write: Create, update, reorder and publish roadmap items and changelog entries.
scopes.board:delete: Delete roadmap items and changelog entries (destructive).
scopes.usage:read: Monthly usage counters and plan limits.

viewer.label: Viewer
viewer.description: Read-only: projects, feedback, roadmap, changelog, usage.

editor.label: Editor
editor.description: Viewer, plus triage feedback, manage the roadmap and changelog, create and update projects.

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Editor, plus delete projects, feedback and board items, and read the audit log.
